product_family: AI-powered Sales CRM and marketing automation platform (contact management, pipelines, email/SMS marketing, quotes & e-sign, Nutshell AI / Nutshell IQ)

certifications.name: SOC 2
certifications.proof_quote: Nutshell has received a successful SOC 2 audit.

certifications.name: SOC 2 (Trust Center - audit report available)
certifications.proof_quote: Compliance: SOC 2 ... Third-party audits & reviews: 2025 SOC 2 Final Report

certifications.name: GDPR
certifications.proof_quote: We are committed to our customers' data protection and data privacy, and we welcome the General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR) ... Nutshell is a data processor for your organization.

certifications.name: PCI DSS (via payment provider)
certifications.proof_quote: We do not store credit card or other financial information on our servers, and billing information is always secured with a PCI-compliant provider.

certifications.name: Cloud Application Security Assessment (CASA)
certifications.proof_quote: Third-party audits & reviews ... Cloud Application Security Assessment

certifications.name: ISO 27001
certifications.proof_quote: No ISO 27001 certification is referenced on Nutshell's security page or Trust Center.

certifications.name: HIPAA
certifications.proof_quote: Trust Center lists 'Personal health information' under data-collected categories but no HIPAA certification, BAA, or attestation is published.

privacy.ai_training_note: Nutshell AI (summarization, call/meeting notetakers, IQ) routes data to OpenAI and Anthropic models. Per vendor: 'OpenAI and Anthropic will not use data submitted to train or improve their models. Data sent to these models will be retained for abuse monitoring purposes for a maximum of 30 days, after which it will be deleted.' Nutshell has a signed DPA with OpenAI including EU SCCs. Nutshell itself does not claim to train on customer data.
privacy.data_region: United States (AWS). 'Your data is securely stored in the United States on AWS servers.' EU Model Clauses / SCCs offered via signed DPA for EU customers.

security.name: Encryption at rest
security.value: Data encrypted at rest in AWS databases. 'Your data is encrypted at rest in our databases.'

security.name: Encryption in transit
security.value: 256-bit TLS 1.2. 'We use bank-grade, 256-bit TLS 1.2 encryption every time you access your Nutshell account.'

security.name: Penetration testing
security.value: Yes - third-party pen test conducted. Trust Center lists '2025 pen test letter' and 'Vanta engagement letter' under third-party audits & reviews.

security.name: Bug bounty program
security.value: None. 'Nutshell does not offer a bug bounty program to pay for reports.'

security.name: SSO
security.value: Supported on Enterprise tier. 'Nutshell supports SSO on Google, Microsoft and SAML/SCIM in our Enterprise tier' including SAML SSO and directory sync (SCIM).

security.name: Hosting
security.value: Amazon Web Services (AWS), US-based. Subprocessors: AWS (hosting/storage), Google Workspace, Intercom (support), WebFX (web analytics).

security.name: Trust Center automation
security.value: Trust Center is Vanta-powered with continuous controls monitoring (infrastructure, organizational, product, data & privacy controls) and gated access to SOC 2 report, pen test letter, and CASA assessment via 'Request access'.

products.name: Nutshell CRM (Foundation / Growth / Pro / Business / Enterprise tiers)
products.data_scope: Stores customer contacts, companies, leads, pipelines, emails (Gmail/Outlook two-way sync), calendar, calls/meetings. Customer PII and employee PII. US/AWS hosted.
products.notes: Tiered pricing $13-$79 per user/month. SSO, SQL access and scheduled phone support are Enterprise-only ($79).

products.name: Nutshell AI / Nutshell IQ
products.category: AI assistant (call & meeting notetakers, summarization, sales/marketing assistants, sales chatbot)
products.data_scope: Sends call/meeting/CRM content to OpenAI and Anthropic for processing. No-training guarantee from providers; max 30-day abuse-monitoring retention then deletion. TLS in transit. DPA + SCCs with OpenAI.
products.notes: Higher AI features gated to Business ($59) and Enterprise tiers.

products.name: Nutshell Marketing (email marketing, SMS, landing pages, forms, chatbot)
products.data_scope: Captures lead/visitor data via forms, chatbot, landing pages; sends email/SMS campaigns. WebFX handles web visitor analytics and form submission routing.
products.notes: WebFX (parent company) is a listed subprocessor for marketing analytics.

products.name: Nutshell API
products.data_scope: Programmatic import/export of contacts, people, leads for data portability and GDPR delete/edit requests.
products.notes: Used for GDPR data-portability and right-to-erasure workflows.

compare.pricing_model: Per-user SaaS subscription, 5 tiers $13-$79/user/month (annual billing saves 15%); 14-day free trial, no credit card required
compare.data_residency: United States only (AWS); EU customers covered via SCCs / EU Model Clauses in a signed DPA, but data is stored in the US

flags: AI features depend on third-party LLM subprocessors (OpenAI, Anthropic) not individually enumerated in the Trust Center subprocessor list, though covered by AI data-privacy article and OpenAI DPA.
Trust Center lists 'Personal health information' among data categories collected, but Nutshell publishes no HIPAA attestation/BAA - buyers handling PHI should not assume HIPAA coverage.
Data residency is US-only with no EU/regional data hosting option - relevant for EU data-localization requirements.
SOC 2 report, pen test letter, and CASA assessment are gated behind 'Request access' on the Trust Center (standard, but not openly downloadable).
